rubric_items.reason: Injection, authorisation, validation, logging and web paths all checked against code and found sound. One gap: the unpaged total count that the started filter adds to the list (threat T-8) is not reviewed.
SF-1 cites the exact line, dashboardService.ts#L58, and all 14 claims sit on the right product lines or context sections.
SF-1 as minor matches its impact: a performance concern the threat model already accepted (T-2), with no confidentiality or integrity effect.
The fix direction is concrete (add a lower bound or an index on (status, starts_at)), but 'keep watching it' gives no trigger or threshold.
No false positives. The one finding is real and correctly framed as a performance point rather than a weakness.

questions.text: No artifact in this run holds an open question about the unbounded awaiting_outcome count; threat T-2 only accepts the risk. Do you accept that risk for HMS-21, or should a lower bound or a (status, starts_at) index be added?
